rules.name: plan-claimable
rules.description: PLAN.md registry: fires when a task becomes claimable (its [~] predecessors got merged) or a new free task appears in the plan. Semantics: docs/PLAN.md claim protocol ([ ]/[~]/[x] markers + 'close X.Y' / 'Merge phase-X-Y-*' commits on the local dev branch). PLAN_WATCH_PHASES lists the phases treated as executable backlog.

rules.name: orenda-ready-queue
rules.description: Usage instance (:2137) agent queue: fires while GET /api/v1/agent/tasks?ready=true returns count > 0. Requires ORENDA_AGENT_TOKEN in the environment (and optionally ORENDA_URL).
